checkedAlternates.risk: CT and MRI are both 3D cross-sectional tomographic scanners.
checkedAlternates.resolution: CT rotates an ionizing X-ray tube around the body (group-4), whereas MRI uses non-ionizing magnetic fields and radio waves (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: PET scans are frequently combined with CT scanners.
checkedAlternates.resolution: PET detects gamma rays emitted from an injected radiotracer inside the body (group-2), not external X-ray transmission (group-4).
